property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp, the reference contract never allows two successful payable fallback calls in the same block to both update pastBlockTime (the second call in the same block must revert due to block.timestamp > pastBlockTime); the mutant using >= can allow a second call in the same block to succeed and thus break this invariant.
change_summary: Change the time comparison from > to >= so calls in the same block timestamp can update pastBlockTime and potentially trigger transfers differently.
